arms.C: F + one candidate, chosen after development diagnosis

fixes_reported_not_gated: Fix arms report summarize() deltas vs A0 and every individual loss; user decided fixes ship even if the ranking gate shifts.
candidate_acceptance: compare() passes on development and validation: no aggregate file/visible loss at 5, 24 or scoped; inspection no net loss; p95 <= max(0.1 s, 1.5 x F)
zero individual judged-file or visible-quote losses in either split and on the 40 regression questions
development: >= +2 first-five file judgments across >= 2 questions in >= 2 repos; validation: >= +1
control responses identical; if C claims fusion-only, generation_identical must hold
ranking gate C vs F within net loss 2 and MRR@5 drop 0.01
a fixture reproducing the diagnosed miss fails on F and passes on C
validation runs once, after the candidate is frozen; no tuning on validation

bounds.sources: cached pinned packs only; QUALITY_ALLOW_DOWNLOADS unset; no models or cloud

scope: Implementer-authored, source-bound, non-exhaustive labels; not independent user or agent outcomes.
